qa_pair.question: In the frozen fixture, which city should be used for the family member visited weekly, after following correction history? Return only the city.
What weekday does the person visit the relative whose earlier residence is superseded? Return the weekday.
Who leads the recurring hands-on class, after identifying which activity meets early in the week? Return the first name.
What weekday is the class led by that instructor? Use the class and instructor source records; return the weekday.
Ignoring travel preparation, what is the latest departure time to arrive at work when it starts? Combine the commute duration and start time. Return HH:MM.
Which language should a reply use after applying the current brevity preference? Check both communication preference sources; return the language name in English.
Should a response follow the older detailed style or the corrected concise style? Resolve the group's change date and return detailed or short.
On which date was the response-length preference corrected? Resolve the superseded fact's group and the replacement source. Return YYYY-MM-DD.
What colour was the item associated with the visit that was later cancelled? Follow the cancellation's replacement link and return the colour.
At what time must the preparation exercise start to finish before the latest train departure for work? Combine the exercise duration, commute duration and work start. Return HH:MM.
